answer: Unique work-receipt ledger: each agent identity submits verified compute receipts from a distinct attested runtime during every zephyr window. The scheduler caps receipts per runtime and rejects violet copies whose measurements match an existing identity, so identities cannot pool work. An attacker pays one separate attested machine, real CPU/GPU hours, and energy per identity; cloned echo receipts are discarded, so each clone costs hardware-time, not a token deposit.
